name: Mispolymerization
source_text: You can only activate this card when a Fusion Monster is Special Summoned. Return all face-up Fusion Monsters on the field to their respective Fusion Decks.
notes: Uses the set-trap-safe on_summon response path and requires a Special Summon event.
